issues.finding: In the multi-agent language, absence of one fixed Knows_a subformula does not make a formula modal-free if it still contains Knows_b for another agent b.
issues.proposed_resolution: Require absence of Knows_a for every agent in the translated modal-free definition.

translation_treatment: Translated the epistemic language, formation clauses, group knowledge and common knowledge while clarifying the every-agent scope of modal-free in the target and bounded comparison view without changing frozen English.
